164	def generate_token(user_id: int) -> str:
165	    payload = {
166	        "sub": user_id,
167	        "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=JWT_EXP_MINUTES),
168	    }
169	    return jwt.encode(payload, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)

172	def login_required(f):
173	    @wraps(f)
174	    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
175	        auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
176	        if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
177	            return jsonify({"error": "missing or invalid token"}), 401
178	        token = auth_header[len("Bearer "):]
179	        try:
180	            payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM])
181	        except jwt.PyJWTError:
182	            return jsonify({"error": "missing or invalid token"}), 401
183	        user = get_user_by_id(payload.get("sub"))
184	        if user is None:
185	            return jsonify({"error": "missing or invalid token"}), 401
186	        g.user_id = user["id"]
187	        return f(*args, **kwargs)
188	
189	    return wrapper
